SiCore pouch, 11.84 Ah, 40.26 Wh, 102 g, 139.0 x 52.5 x 6.32 mm at 30% charge, 3.4 V (2.5-4.2); 400 Wh/kg and 875 Wh/L at C/5; 1C continuous, 3C for 30 s; charge C/3 at most; 300 cycles to 80% at +0.3C/-1C full depth, 700 to 90% at 70% depth; discharge -20 to 55 C, charge 10 to 55 C; 15 PSI compression recommended; UN 38.3, IEC 62133, CE, BIS.
